coverage_statement: This package freezes a sparse, non-public Romagna curation boundary from 8 August through 31 December 1502. It does not claim a complete itinerary, complete Romagna coverage, direct evidence for every date, reviewed historical geometry or representative world history.

known_gaps.description: No source-backed changing Duchy of Romagna polygon has been digitized, georeferenced or independently reviewed.
known_gaps.effect: Both Region versions remain geometry-withheld and cannot be rendered or promoted.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Freeze source images and rights, define the reconstruction question, method, CRS/control points and residuals, then complete two independent geometry reviews.

known_gaps.description: Selected sources support dated or datable presence contexts but do not establish the routes between Rimini, Cesena, Cesenatico and Imola.
known_gaps.effect: Three inferred gaps remain without line or corridor geometry.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Retain unknown_route unless a reviewed source supports a route or an explicitly analytical uncertain corridor.

known_gaps.description: The university chronology pins the dated Rimini, Cesena and Cesenatico entries to Manuscript L folios 78r, 46v and 66v, but no rights-cleared facsimiles are frozen; the separate Cesena wall-survey association with folios 9r–10r has only an institutional-itinerary locator in the frozen source set.
known_gaps.effect: The dated presence Claims can proceed to textual review. The separate Cesena wall-survey folio Claim is rejected from the Gate C supported set without being declared historically false.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Retain the rejection unless a rights-compliant facsimile or critical-edition locator is frozen and independently reviewed.

known_gaps.description: No independent semantic/content or validator-integrity review has been completed for the historical slice.
known_gaps.effect: The package remains candidate_not_ready and promotion_allowed=false.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Complete two independent reviews on one frozen commit with no unresolved critical or material finding.

known_gaps.description: Only one global simultaneity candidate is selected.
known_gaps.effect: The slice cannot imply representative global coverage.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Validate the comparison task and either justify one anchor as sufficient or add the smallest additional source-bound 1502 context.

known_gaps.description: Issue #331 is paused, so documented encounter, interaction, influence and causal predicates are prohibited.
known_gaps.effect: Only deterministic derived co-presence may be computed and it cannot be stored as a historical Relation.
known_gaps.exit_condition: Resume and accept #331 before introducing any documented Relation predicate.
